name: passwordGenerator
description: Generates a strong, cryptographically secure random password based on specified rules.
longDescription: This tool generates a random password using cryptographically secure methods, with options like length, inclusion of numbers, special characters, and capital letters.

length.description: The length of the password to generate.

includeNumbers.description: Whether to include numbers in the password.

includeSpecialChars.description: Whether to include special characters (e.g., @, #, $) in the password.

includeUppercase.description: Whether to include uppercase letters in the password.

code: ({ length, includeNumbers = true, includeSpecialChars = true, includeUppercase = true }) => { const lower = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'; const numbers = '0123456789'; const special = '!@#$%^&*()_+[]{}|;:,.<>?'; const upper = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'; let chars = lower; if (includeNumbers) chars += numbers; if (includeSpecialChars) chars += special; if (includeUppercase) chars += upper; const getRandomValue = (max) => { const randomBuffer = new Uint32Array(1); window.crypto.getRandomValues(randomBuffer); return randomBuffer[0] % max; }; let password = ''; for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) { password += chars[getRandomValue(chars.length)]; } return password; }
